text:
Alex Ovechkin is playing his final NHL season, and the farewell has already started: a ceremony for his Capitals franchise assist record, a pregame moment with Jayden Daniels at a Commanders game. He is 41, with a Stanley Cup, nine Rocket Richards and the all-time goals record in the books.

What hasn't come is goals. He has one in 22 games and none in his last 17. Our numbers say that is mostly bad luck. He has 5.6 expected goals on his own shots, his chances over the last ten games are slightly above his usual rate, and he is shooting 2.6% against a talent range of 10 to 14. The shot still clocks in the 96th percentile for top speed. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 94th percentile for chances from in front of the net last season.

The honest caveats: he is skating 13:37 a night, his skating speed sits near the bottom of the league, and Evolving-Hockey had him outrunning his chances in 2025-26. But the looks are still there, and that is the part a slump can't fake.
headline: Alex Ovechkin's last lap, and the missing goals
